sloka: प्रयाते तु सहस्राक्षे राघवः सपरिच्छदः ।अग्नि होत्रम् उपासीनम् शरभंगम् उपागमत् ॥३-५-२५॥
transliteration: prayāte tu sahasrākṣe rāghavaḥ saparicchadaḥ ।agni hotram upāsīnam śarabhaṁgam upāgamat ॥3-5-25॥

translations.english: When Indra departed like that, Rama with his retinue (Sita and Lakshmana) went to Sarabhanga who was sitting by the side of the firealtar (for Agnihotra).
